title: Hardcoded support token stored as a module-level constant
detail: src/aurora/aurora-cli/src/index.js:L7 declares SUPPORT_TOKEN as a string literal with a hardcoded credential value beginning 'xoxb-'; this constant is re-exported at L25, exposing the credential to any code that imports the module.

title: eval() executes caller-supplied expression string without restriction
detail: src/aurora/aurora-cli/src/index.js:L15 passes the expression parameter directly to eval() inside a filter callback; any caller that supplies an attacker-controlled string gains arbitrary JavaScript code execution in the Node.js process.
